stem: Which line provides the best evidence that Jim has high expectations for himself?

options.label: A
options.text: He does not strike the mighty blow he sees in his mind.

options.label: B
options.text: He blames himself for the boy's lack of success.

options.label: C
options.text: He does not want it to stop.

options.label: D
options.text: He silently chides himself for being cheap.
